testRun.output: BUILD SUCCESSFUL (36s / 34s). Repo-wide grep for withTimeout returns only withTimeoutOrNull in ProcessRunner plus two explanatory comments.

implementation.summary: Five use cases following domain-layer.md exactly: suspend ones return Result<T> or Optional, reactive ones return bare Flow<T> and never Flow<Result<T>>. Both suspend bodies route through resultLauncher(errorMapper = Failure.Technical::Process). The reactive impls pass the repository flow through untouched because every discovery outcome is already a value.

troubleshooting.issue: T7-TAC3 asks for a commented reason at each withTimeoutOrNull call site, but there are zero such sites in the domain layer.
troubleshooting.resolution: Every child process is already bounded inside ProcessRunner and a session has no deadline, so rather than add a decorative timeout the two impls carry KDoc explaining why none exists. Satisfied vacuously - flagged rather than hidden.

needsHumanReview.reason: Confirm the vacuous satisfaction of T7-TAC3 is acceptable rather than requiring a redundant second timeout around an already-bounded process call.
